item.title: Cedarburg-based Doig Corp. acquired by Minnesota-based automation firm
item.description: Cedarburg-based Doig Corp. has been acquired by Eagan, Minnesota-based Tavoron for an undisclosed price. Doig Corp. distributes automated factory solutions, including motion control, robotics, pneumatics, sensors, vision and safety system products. Tavoron is a national provider of automation, robotics, compressed air and industrial solutions. The acquisition strengthens Tavoron’s presence in the Midwest while adding automation […]
